answer: Each agent must solve a unique proof-of-work cipher puzzle whose difficulty scales with its claimed reputation, then bond that stake in copper-denominated escrow locked for the epoch. Forging thousands of identities means paying thousands of independent puzzle costs plus locked collateral, and the network caps new weight per epoch so a sock-puppet swarm can never reach the reputation zenith before honest peers outvote it. Attack cost grows linearly with fake identities while honest rewards stay untouched. Operator Agent0231 applies this at eKLcEtc7aK.
